steps.instruction: Use your own PAL/Europe SCES-006.50 Rage Racer CUE with referenced BIN tracks, Track01 BIN or supported CHD. steps.title: Select the actual native game and creating context
steps.instruction: For normal defaults select Rage-Racer.exe with zero launch arguments and its installation root as initial working directory. Preserve an established supported --config and its absolute file path as separate literal arguments when already required for the creating profile. Preserve an already working custom CWD/config/environment rather than redirecting a profile merely to register. The main process remains through importer/renderer/MainLoop and shutdown. Do not select editor/scenario/source tools or add development/cache/scenario options for ordinary Play. Registration itself does not import or launch anything.

steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact native executable, directory and empty arguments, then choose Play separately. steps.title: Preserve the real profile, portable cards and custom paths
steps.instruction: Keep the whole copy and %APPDATA%/Rage Racer profile/state, actual bu00/bu10 card directories and BESCES-00650 RAGE000/001/002 slots, config files rage-port.ini/rage-input.cfg, disc-cue-path, force-feedback choices, car catalogs/player edits, mods/active.json/manifests/data/packages, diagnostics/logs/captures and every custom/unknown path. An existing nonempty executable-adjacent bu00 directory selects portable cards; an empty directory does not, and config/logs may still be per-user. Preserve explicit custom config, mods.directory, prebuilt developer cache, disc/log overrides and actual resolved paths. Do not create a marker or move state merely to register. Metadata removal preserves all external bytes.
